2609.17394.title: Coding Agents Have Converged: Why the SWE-bench Leaderboard Can No Longer Order Its Top Entries, and What to Measure Instead
2609.17394.paper_summary: Small differences on coding-agent leaderboards are often read as an ordering of systems. We audit whether the published verdicts support this reading, using 254 SWE-bench submissions across four splits without running models. On Verified, the leading two entries each resolve 396 of 500 instances. The top ten share 285 successes and 51 failures, leaving 164 instances that distinguish their outcomes. Frontier solution sets have median nesting 0.935 against a score-implied baseline of 0.774, indicating strongly shared successes. Scores also depend on the evaluated model-scaffold pair: observed within-model scaffold ranges reach 29.8 percentage points, compared with the 8.8-point spread of the top thirty. Six of nine cell-mean interaction tests remain significant after Holm correction, although this observational design does not identify causal scaffold effects. Exact paired McNemar tests separate none of the 29 adjacent Verified top-thirty pairs at alpha=0.05, while the larger Test split separates 14 of 23. A stated leader-based rule yields three descriptive tiers, or two after Holm correction; non-rejection does not establish equivalence. We release the partition and a five-step audit protocol that profiles shared outcomes, tests paired differences, reports grouping sensitivity, and estimates the instance budget needed for resolution. The results motivate reporting comparison-set-specific resolution and model-scaffold provenance instead of interpreting small aggregate gaps as established rank differences.
2609.17394.paper_summary_zh: 小的差異在編碼代理的排行榜上通常被解讀為系統的排序。我們審核已發表的判決是否支持這種解讀，使用254個SWE-bench提交的數據，跨越四個分組而不運行模型。在Verified中，前兩個條目各自解決了500個實例中的396個。前十名共享285次成功和51次失敗，留下164個實例來區分它們的結果。前沿解決方案集的中位數嵌套為0.935，相對於得分暗示的基線0.774，顯示出強烈的共享成功。得分也依賴於評估的模型-支架對：觀察到的模型內支架範圍達到29.8個百分點，而前30名的範圍為8.8個百分點。九個單元均值互動測試中有六個在Holm校正後仍然顯著，儘管這種觀察設計並未識別因果支架效應。精確的配對McNemar測試在alpha=0.05下未能區分29對相鄰的Verified前30名，而較大的測試分組則區分了23對中的14對。一個基於領導者的規則產生了三個描述性層級，或在Holm校正後為兩個；不拒絕並不建立等價性。我們發布了分區和五步審核協議，該協議概述了共享結果，測試配對差異，報告分組敏感性，並估算解決所需的實例預算。結果促使報告比較集特定的解決方案和模型-支架來源，而不是將小的總體差距解釋為既定的排名差異。
